# Your Machines, Now

> A live, read-only view of how Joel's machines stand and what each
> carries: the mycelium's cells on it, where it meets his home network,
> the code it holds and its own figures. Then the mycelium, the network
> and the code across them, each judged from its own owner's answer.

- [The page](index.html): a headline counting the machines and how they
  stand, the machines drawn as the piers of a bridge, a section for
  each machine with its four ties and what can be done with it through
  the launcher, then the other three parts across them and the
  builders the machines send Nix builds to, each with its health
  (good, watch, bad or not read), walked by keyboard or pointer.
- [The page as text](index.md): how each is judged, the keys, and what
  the data holds.
- A machine's address on the page: `#machine=` and its name, which
  opens the page with the cursor on that machine.
- The data: the system daemon's records, which the page watches live
  over the sites' server at /feed/system. An agent on the machine runs
  `system --json` itself.
- [All his sites](../llms.txt): the home this page sits in.
